استخرجن (form X)
# اِسْتَخْرَجْنَ (istaḵrajna) /is.tax.rad͡ʒ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَخْرَجَ (istaḵraja)
# اُسْتُخْرِجْنَ (ustuḵrijna) /us.tux.rid͡ʒ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَخْرَجَ (istaḵraja)
# اِسْتَخْرِجْنَ (istaḵrijna) /is.tax.rid͡ʒ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَخْرَجَ (istaḵraja)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
